# Genetic Ancestry Classification

Although fairly homogeneous and of predominantly European ancestry, the FHS population contains a non-trivial degree admixture. To detect outliers, I projected samples onto the top 20 PCs derived from 1000 Genomes data using the `bigsnpr` and `bigutilsr` packages, and selected samples whose 20 nearest neighbors in the 20 dimensional PC space were all part of the 1000 Genomes EUR superpopulation. I removed 49 respondents who did not meet these criteria, most of whom were classified as part of the Admixed Americans (AMR) superpopulation. As further verification, for remaining respondents I cross-checked genetic ancestry classification with self-reported race/ethnicity (when available). After restricting to European ancestry, I then used `KING` to extract a subset of unrelated respondents and `bigsnpr` to project 20 PCs derived from this subset to the remaining FHS sample. 

## Set Up Reference and Target Samples

* Reference: 1000G (loaded below)
* Target: Previously QC-filtered FHS data (`affy37_qc3`)

```{r}
## Download 1000G Reference Data: download_1000G("PC_Data")
pc_dat_path <- c("PC_Data/")
ref_1000G_fams <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.fam"))
ref_1000G_pops <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.fam2"), header = T, sep = "\t")
```

## Project FHS Sample onto 1000G

* `bed_projectPCA` outputs a list of three elements:
    (1) `big_SVD` object which can be used within predict() function to generate PCs of ref sample
    (2) PCs of target sample using simple projection
    (3) PCs of target sample using OADP projection (option used here)
* Note that ambiguous alleles are automatically removed when setting `strand_flip = T` (the default) 

```{r}
obj.bed_ref <- bed(paste0(pc_dat_path, "1000G_phase3_common_norel.bed"))
obj.bed_fhs <- bed(paste0(pc_dat_path, "affy37_qc3.bed"))
ref.to.fhs_project <- bed_projectPCA(obj.bed_ref, obj.bed_fhs, strand_flip = T, k = 20, ncores = 6)
```

## Extract Ref/Target Sample PCs and Superpop Labels

```{r}
## (1) PCs of ref sample (1000G) using predict()
ref_pcs <- predict(ref.to.fhs_project$obj.svd.ref) %>% as.data.frame() %>% bind_cols(ref_1000G_pops)

## (2) PCs of target (FHS) sample using simple projection (not using)
## fhs_fullsamp_pcs1 <- ref.to.fhs_project$simple_proj %>% as.data.frame()

## (3) PCs of target (FHS) sample using OADP projection
fhs_fullsamp_pcs2 <- ref.to.fhs_project$OADP_proj %>% as.data.frame() 

## KNN Test/OADP Projection to Determine SuperPop of FHS sample
knn_1000G.p2 <- knn(train = ref_pcs[,1:20], test = fhs_fullsamp_pcs2[,1:20], cl = ref_pcs$SuperPopulation, prob = T, k = 20, l = 20)
summary(knn_1000G.p2)

## PCs for FHS sample only with added Superpop classifier
fhs_fullsamp_pcs3 <- bind_cols(fhs_fullsamp_pcs2, "SuperPopulation" = knn_1000G.p2) %>% 
    rename_with(~paste0("PC", 1:20), paste0("V", 1:20))

## Combine with pedigree info
fhs_qc3_fam <- read.table(paste0(pc_dat_path, "affy37_qc3.fam")) %>% 
  select("SHAREID" = V2, "PEDNO" = V1, "FSHARE" = V3, "MSHARE" = V4, "SEX" = 5)

fhs_pcs3_plus_ped <- fhs_qc3_fam %>% bind_cols(fhs_fullsamp_pcs3) %>% relocate(SuperPopulation, .after = SEX) %>%
  ## 35 NAs means classified as ambiguous by PCA analysis - Recode to make clear ancestry still tested
  mutate(SuperPopulation = case_match(SuperPopulation, NA ~ "AMBIG", .default = SuperPopulation))

## Combine Reference (1000G) PCs/Known SuperPop labels with FHS PCs/Predicted SuperPop Labels
fhs_plus_ref_pcs <- ref_pcs %>% rename_with(~paste0("PC", 1:20), paste0("V", 1:20)) %>%
  relocate(REFID = sample.ID, SEX = sex, Population, SuperPopulation) %>% select(-PopulationDescription) %>%
  bind_rows(fhs_pcs3_plus_ped) %>%
  relocate(SHAREID, PEDNO, FSHARE, MSHARE, .after = REFID)

## Save compiled components
write.table(fhs_plus_ref_pcs, file = "fhs_plus_ref_pcs.txt", row.names = F, quote = F)
```

## Cross-Check Ancestry with Self-Identified Race

* Examine congruence of ancestry classifications (SuperPopulation) and self-reported racial identities among each respondent and his or her immediate family members (father, mother, full siblings)
* Extend pedigree to include...
    1. Indicators for availability of maternal/paternal genetic data
    2. Maternal/paternal ancestry classifications
    3. Maternal/paternal self-reported racial identities
    4. IIDs for all grandparents (PGF, PGM, MGF, MGM)
    5. Indicators for availability of grandparental genetic data
    6. Counts of non-white SuperPopulation cases and non-white racial identity cases within each nuclear family


```{r}
## Ancestry classifications as determined above
gen_ancestry <- read.table("fhs_fam_ancestry.txt", header = T) %>%
    mutate(V2 = as.character(V2)) %>%
    mutate(SuperPop = case_when(is.na(SuperPopulation) ~ "UNCLASS", 
                                .default = SuperPopulation))

## Combine racial identity self-reports (from core phenotype files) for all relevant cohorts
pheno_path <- "FHS_Pheno_Dat/"
self_race_all <- bind_rows(
    read.csv(paste0(pheno_path, "g3_phenos_unstd.csv")) %>% select(IID = SHAREID, RACE_E1, RACE_E2),
    read.csv(paste0(pheno_path, "g2n_phenos_unstd.csv")) %>% select(IID = SHAREID, RACE_E1, RACE_E2),
    read.csv(paste0(pheno_path, "g2_phenos_unstd.csv")) %>% select(IID = SHAREID, RACE_E1 = RACE)) %>%
    mutate(IID = as.character(IID))

plink_qc4 <- read.table("Affy550K_qc4.fam", header = F) %>%
    select(PEDNO = V1, IID = V2, SEX = V5, FSHARE = V3, MSHARE = V4) %>%
    mutate(IID = as.character(IID),
           F_GENO = case_when(FSHARE %in% IID ~ 1, .default = 0),
           M_GENO = case_when(MSHARE %in% IID ~ 1, .default = 0))

## Saved as ext_race_pedigree.txt
plink_qc4_pt2 <- plink_qc4 %>%
    ## Merge parent info; MSHARE/FSHARE of parents become grandparent IDs of focal SHAREID
    left_join(plink_qc4 %>% select(IID, PGF = FSHARE, PGF_GENO = F_GENO, 
                                   PGM = MSHARE, PGM_GENO = M_GENO), by = c("FSHARE" = "IID")) %>%
    left_join(plink_qc4 %>% select(IID, MGF = FSHARE, MGF_GENO = F_GENO,
                                   MGM = MSHARE, MGM_GENO = M_GENO), by = c("MSHARE" = "IID")) %>%
    left_join(gen_ancestry %>% select(V2, SuperPop), by = c("IID" = "V2")) %>%
    left_join(gen_ancestry %>% select(V2, P.SuperPop = SuperPop), by = c("FSHARE" = "V2")) %>%
    left_join(gen_ancestry %>% select(V2, M.SuperPop = SuperPop), by = c("MSHARE" = "V2")) %>%
    left_join(self_race_all) %>%
    left_join(self_race_all %>% rename(P.RACE_E1 = RACE_E1, P.RACE_E2 = RACE_E2), by = c("FSHARE" = "IID")) %>%
    left_join(self_race_all %>% rename(M.RACE_E1 = RACE_E1, M.RACE_E2 = RACE_E2), by = c("MSHARE" = "IID")) %>%
    group_by(FSHARE, MSHARE) %>% 
    mutate(NonWhite_Gen = sum(c(SuperPop != "EUR", P.SuperPop != "EUR", M.SuperPop != "EUR"), na.rm = T),
           NonWhite_Self = sum(c(RACE_E1 != "WHITE", RACE_E2 != "WHITE",
                                 P.RACE_E1 != "WHITE", P.RACE_E2 != "WHITE",
                                 M.RACE_E1 != "WHITE", M.RACE_E2 != "WHITE"), na.rm = T)) %>%
    mutate(across(c(NonWhite_Gen, NonWhite_Self), ~case_when(FSHARE == 0 | MSHARE == 0 ~ 0,
                                                             .default = .))) %>%
    ungroup()

## Saved as race_pedigree.txt
## race_drop_list.txt is derived from this subset
race_filter <- plink_qc4_pt2 %>% filter(
    NonWhite_Gen > 0 | NonWhite_Self > 0 | SuperPop != "EUR" | RACE_E1 != "WHITE" | RACE_E2 != "WHITE")
write.table(race_filter, file = "race_pedigree.txt", sep = "\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Apply Ancestry Filter

```{bash Remove Non-White Sample}
## 68 removed
plink1.9 \
  --bfile Affy550K_QC_Sets/Affy550K_qc4 \
  --remove race_drop_list.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_QC_Sets/Affy550K_qc5

## KING Confirmation: "No cryptic relatedness (up to the 1-degree) is found.""
king -b \
  Affy550K_QC_Sets/Affy550K_qc5.bed \
  --related \
  --degree 1 \
  --prefix KING_Output/Affy550K_qc5
```


# Extract Genetic PCs for PGI Analysis

```{r}
## Apply to FHS Data
fhs_bedfile <- "PC_Data/Affy550K_qc5.bed"
fhs_fam <- read.table("PC_Data/Affy550K_qc5.fam")

## 731 respondents with no relationship ties (beyond set kinship threshold)
## Use to project remaining sample
obj.fhsbed <- bed(fhs_bedfile)
fhs_rel_pairs <- snp_plinkKINGQC("./plink2", fhs_bedfile, make.bed = FALSE, ncores = 6)
fhs_nonrel <- fhs_fam %>% filter(!(V2 %in% fhs_rel_pairs$IID1 | V2 %in% fhs_rel_pairs$IID2))

## Create index for non-relative reference
ind.norel <- match(fhs_nonrel[,"V2"], obj.fhsbed$fam$sample.ID)
obj.svd <- bed_autoSVD(obj.fhsbed, ind.row = ind.norel, k = 20, ncores = 6)
proj <- bed_projectSelfPCA(obj.svd, obj.fhsbed, ind.row = rows_along(obj.fhsbed)[-ind.norel], ncores = 6)

## Can't just bind rows from ref/proj set in proj; need to align with original indices in order to map to sample.ID
PCs <- matrix(NA, nrow(obj.fhsbed), ncol(obj.svd$u))
PCs[ind.norel, ] <- predict(proj[["obj.svd.ref"]])
PCs[-ind.norel, ] <- proj$OADP_proj
dimnames(PCs)[[2]] <- paste('PC', 1:20, sep='')
PCs <- PCs %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(SHAREID = obj.fhsbed$fam$sample.ID) %>% relocate(SHAREID)

write.table(PCs, "PC_Data/FHS_PCs.txt", quote = F, row.names = F)
```
